text.tspan: FRAME — A third window opens at the edge of the map, the same size
and brightness as ChatGPT's, in the critique's typeface but with no
byline. Its title bar reads SKEPTIC — COMPOSITE.
boxes are the report's research map. You have drawn the authors'

ACTION — Curt does not argue. He runs a header across the whole
hypothesis field — THE REPORT'S QUESTIONS, NOT THE
RECORD'S — and leaves every dotted outline exactly as it was.
DIALOGUE — CURT — “That's the page 086 mistake. Four days later.”
